artifact.description: PASS case for R3/Observation elaboration: three Observations on one Occurrence — focusTarget only, duration only, and both together — all independently valid.
artifact.notes: Confirms observation-with-focus-target-but-no-duration and observation-with-duration-but-no-focus-target are both independently valid (neither field requires the other), and that both may co-occur. duration is a plain non-negative number with no mandated unit — it carries no interpretation of engagement or interest.
